blocks.text:
## What you will see

In Bogotá, you will walk through La Candelaria, visit the Gold Museum, Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Museum, and see Plaza de Bolívar, the Cathedral, the presidential residence and the Palace of Justice.

Medellín reveals the country's modern history through its different neighbourhoods. The route first takes you through Pueblito Paisa, the city centre and the administrative districts, then through El Poblado. A separate walking tour focuses on Comuna 13, its street art and urban transformation.

The following day takes you beyond Medellín. You will travel to La Piedra del Peñol and Guatapé, see the reservoir and brightly coloured façades with zócalos, and have the option to add a climb up the rock or a boat ride.

In Cartagena, the route takes you to La Popa, San Felipe de Barajas Castle, Las Bóvedas and the historic centre. For your free day, the programme recommends an optional trip to San Pedro de Majagua in the Rosario Islands.
